name: APIVerveAnagramPuzzleGenerator
summary: Anagram Puzzle Generator creates word puzzles where players rearrange scrambled letters to form valid words, with optional hints.
description:
Anagram Puzzle Generator creates word puzzles where players rearrange scrambled letters to form valid words, with optional hints.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Anagram Puzzle Generator from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
